newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya coffee prices ease at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya coffee prices ease at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan coffee prices eased dragged down by an excess supply of coffee at the weekly coffee auction in Nairobi on Tuesday, auction officials said.
"The current prices which are on average high for our local market experienced a bit of resistance because at this level, buyers tend to be a bit cautious," one trader said.
Grade Cs averaged $210 per 50-kg from $236.5 while grade ABs averaged $232.5 from $250.
The Coffee Board of Kenya said it sold all 40,480 60-kg bags of coffee it had on offer compared to 35,898 bags sold last week.
